sections.heading: What is trending: “iphone duo”
paragraphs: “iphone duo” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for MX (snapshot taken 2026-09-09T18:36:44+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 20,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from El Financiero, Milenio, Xataka México. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Apple Event 2026: Presentan el nuevo iPhone 18 EN VIVO” — El Financiero
“Nuevo iPhone Duo: el celular plegable de Apple que se transforma en iPad” — Xataka México
“¿Cuánto costará el iPhone 18 Pro y Pro MAX? Aquí puedes comprarlo a su precio de LANZAMIENTO” — Milenio

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Wed, 9 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-09T18:36:44+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-09T18:37:43+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
